import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem finite_pointwise_order_locus_as_continuous_zero_set
  {α : Type} [MetricSpace α]
  (n : ℕ) (f g : Fin n → α → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  ∃ A : α → ℝ,
    (∀ x, A x = (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => max (f i x - g i x) 0))) ∧
      Continuous A ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ A x) ∧
      (∀ x, A x = 0 ↔ ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x) ∧
      ({x | ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x} = A ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ)) := by
  let A : α → ℝ :=
    fun x => Finset.univ.sum (fun i => max (f i x - g i x) 0)
  
  have hA :
      ∀ x, A x = Finset.univ.sum (fun i => max (f i x - g i x) 0) := by
    intro x
    rfl
  
  have hcont : Continuous A := by
    unfold A
    apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro i hi
    exact ((hf i).sub (hg i)).max continuous_const
  
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ A x := by
    intro x
    unfold A
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => le_max_right _ _)
  
  have hzero : ∀ x, A x = 0 ↔ ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x := by
    intro x
    unfold A
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hz :
          ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
            max (f i x - g i x) 0 = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun i hi => le_max_right _ _)).mp hx
      intro i
      have hle : f i x - g i x ≤ 0 := by
        calc
          f i x - g i x ≤ max (f i x - g i x) 0 := le_max_left _ _
          _ = 0 := hz i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact sub_nonpos.mp hle
    · intro hx
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      exact max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (hx i))
  
  refine ⟨A, hA, hcont, hnonneg, hzero, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    (hzero x).symm
